scope: All 34 catalog product routes, current local catalog and built HTML, every referenced raster asset's actual metadata, 26 unique gallery images and 28 unique Hero images inspected in contact sheets, internal source/edit/QA records. summary.fullyApprovedPages: Not assigned: no fresh complete per-page visual acceptance in this audit. Conditional/QA gaps do not mean all those products have wrong images.

rules.P0: Confirmed geometry conflict across Hero, photo and lower drawing; correct first.

rules.nativePixels: Metadata describes saved final files; original photograph dimensions must be read from source records, not inferred from AI output.
rules.history: Earlier records saying local-only/unpublished are historical snapshots. Deployment of source d2bfd3f completed through publication commit 385d294; do not use stale snapshot flags as current deployment status.
